title: Vaults/escrow/order cluster (cVault, OTSea, Jupiter Offerbook, PiggyBank, TONCO V2, Extended)
closed_reasons: cVault: rLP holds 99.974% of SLP but exposes no unwrap; rebase hard-reverts; ERC95 wrappers 1:1 backed and skim-empty
OTSea: cancel/claim/fill paths party-bound; DL $582k is the sum of open sell-order ETH asks, not escrow
PiggyBank: deposit and redeem share total_shares f72; same-epoch round trip loses 1 raw unit; claim bound to redemption.user
TONCO V2: PAY_TO exit 111; live-pool POOLV3_INIT exit 82; fake notify forwards to a sender-derived pool
Extended: withdraw/transfer need operator nonce + user-signed approval; treasury Core-only; vault Core-only
key_facts: cVault real notional $6.33M ($6.12M SLP + $213.6k holder-owned); only $213.6k is H-O
OTSea real escrow ~$7k; DL $582k = 187.60 ETH + 49.75 ETH of open sell-order asks
Offerbook escrow $1,340,591 (205,117 USDC hard floor); PiggyBank managed $1,735,629 (96-99% off-vault)
TONCO two-pool TVL $2,405,239; Extended treasury $115,455,104 (DL Spot is an overlap of Perps)
All six targets are negative for E-U; the sizeable residual risks are privileged (admin upgrade, operator, off-vault custody)
caveats: P total overlaps H-O custody and is not additive
Offerbook binary upgraded 7 days before review and includes unaudited yield code; PiggyBank source is private
Extended: exact source commit for live class 0x2009d not proven; Arc migration scheduled 2026-10-22
Memecoin escrow/collateral marked at spot, not realizable
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 across all six deployments; the headline numbers are a locked SLP (cVault), a DefiLlama ask-side artifact (OTSea), and correctly-closed order/NAV/pool/operator state machines.
